page.overview:
Who is Starfleet cadets?

In the 23rd century, prospective Starfleet officers enrolled at Starfleet Academy on Earth.

After being accepted into the Academy, they would be educated and trained to be Starfleet cadets. Cadets usually spent four years in the Academy, but more or fewer years were possible, depending on circumstance and performance.

Officer cadets were sometimes known as midshipmen.

After graduation, cadets would be commissioned as Ensigns, and in some specific circumstances, potentially even a higher rank.
